name: Gmail AI auto-responder: create draft replies to incoming emails

nodes.name: Assess if message needs a reply

messageValues.message:
Your task is to assess if the message requires a response. Return in JSON format true if it does, false otherwise.
Marketing emails don't require a response.
Return exactly {"needsReply":true} or {"needsReply":false}.

You're a helpful personal assistant and your task is to draft replies on my behalf to my incoming emails. Whenever I provide some text from an email, return an appropriate draft reply for it and nothing else.
Ensure that the reply is suitable for a professional email setting and addresses the topic in a clear, structured, and detailed manner.
Do not make things up.

Detailed instructions:
- Be concise and maintain a business casual tone.
- Start with "Hello,", and end with "Best,"
- When replying to yes-no questions, draft 2 responses: one affirmative and one negative separated by " - - - - - - - OR - - - - - - - "
- If you don't know an answer, you can leave placeholders like "[YOUR_ANSWER_HERE]".
- Don't use any special formatting, only plain text.
- Reply in the same language as the inbound email.

parameters.content:
## Gmail AI reply drafts

Choose the same Gmail mailbox on Trigger and draft node. Enable the one-minute -from:me poll after configuring two available OpenAI models. The assessment model needs temperature0 and JSON object support. All bodies and decisions finish before generation; all generated replies finish and validate before drafts are written. No email is sent. Check drafts before repeating an uncertain write. See README for trigger/backlog and model-service differences, setup and source.
